## Purpose

This document produces every number and figure in the manuscript and ESM that
depends on the estimated severity. It reads the outputs of the two evaluation
Rmds, so no Stan model is refitted:

* `p7_vit_dist_state_models_v2_compe_eval_fix20260930.Rmd` →
  `eval_sources_model_fix20260930.rds` (full model and leave-one-channel-out)
* `p7_vit_dist_state_models_v2_compe_on_eval_fix20261001.Rmd` →
  `eval_sources_model_on_add_fix.rds` (single-channel models)

The exposure is `estim_mean_dmg` exactly as computed there (24-h time-weighted
mean severity, lines 353–368 / 363–378). The outcome is `death_in_30days`.

Run order and inputs: see `README.md` of the repository. Working directory:
`p7_vit_dist_state_models_comp/`. Runtime: a few minutes; the optional
convergence section reads the nine saved fits (about 17 GB) and takes longer.

Only aggregate results are printed or saved. The outputs go to `figs_final_v23/`
(figures as PDF, numbers as CSV and TXT).

## Settings

```{r config}
cfg <- list(
  eval_ex = "./eval_sources_model_fix20260930.rds",
  eval_on = "./eval_sources_model_on_add_fix.rds",
  ts_ex   = "20260929_100700.473068",
  ts_on   = "20260930_004943.381441",
  f_icu   = "../p2_unplanned_ICUadmission/dat/icu_target20240517_044716.297905.rds",
  f_p5    = "../p5_vit_dist_inhosp/dat/df_j20261106_183454.947914.rds",  # 2026-11-07; mean BP from complete records
  out     = "./figs_final_v23",
  check_against_html = TRUE,   # AUCs must equal those printed in the 10/1 HTMLs
  run_convergence    = TRUE,   # reads the nine fits (slow)
  seed_bootstrap     = 42,
  B_bootstrap        = 2000
)
## A test harness may pre-define `cfg_override` (list) to change any setting.
if (exists("cfg_override")) cfg <- utils::modifyList(cfg, cfg_override)

key_ex <- function(x) sprintf(".//ssm_801_4_redvar_rs_ex%s_%s_exres_list.rds", x, cfg$ts_ex)
key_on <- function(x) sprintf(".//ssm_801_4_redvar_rs_on%s_%s_exres_list.rds", x, cfg$ts_on)
if (is.null(cfg$fit_files)) cfg$fit_files <- c(
  full    = key_ex("ZERO"),  exTEMPR = key_ex("TEMPR"), exRESP = key_ex("RESP"),
  exBPM   = key_ex("BPM"),   exPULSE = key_ex("PULSE"),
  onPULSE = key_on("PULSE"), onBPM   = key_on("BPM"),   onRESP = key_on("RESP"),
  onTEMPR = key_on("TEMPR"))

## AUC (glm fitted probability -> ROCR) printed in the knitted HTMLs of 2026-10-01
auc_html <- c(full = 0.6303763, exBPM = 0.624552, exPULSE = 0.6014785,
              exRESP = 0.6173835, exTEMPR = 0.6442652,
              onBPM = 0.5871416, onPULSE = 0.6202957, onRESP = 0.5518466,
              onTEMPR = 0.5234869)
dir.create(cfg$out, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 0. Inputs

```{r inputs}
inputs <- c(cfg$eval_ex, cfg$eval_on, cfg$f_icu, cfg$f_p5)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(inputs)))
data.frame(file = inputs, md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(inputs)))
```

```{r load}
icu <- readRDS(cfg$f_icu) %>% distinct(JIPAD_ID, PT_ID, ADM_DT)
ev_ex <- readRDS(cfg$eval_ex)$l_data[["death_in_30days"]]
ev_on <- readRDS(cfg$eval_on)$l_data[["death_in_30days"]]
keys <- c(full = key_ex("ZERO"), exTEMPR = key_ex("TEMPR"), exRESP = key_ex("RESP"),
          exBPM = key_ex("BPM"), exPULSE = key_ex("PULSE"),
          onPULSE = key_on("PULSE"), onBPM = key_on("BPM"),
          onRESP = key_on("RESP"), onTEMPR = key_on("TEMPR"))
src <- c(rep("ex", 5), rep("on", 4)); names(src) <- names(keys)
D <- lapply(names(keys), function(nm) {
  L <- if (src[[nm]] == "ex") ev_ex else ev_on
  d <- L[[keys[[nm]]]]
  if (is.null(d)) stop("not found in the evaluation output: ", keys[[nm]])
  d %>% transmute(JIPAD_ID, y = as.numeric(death_in_30days), x = estim_mean_dmg) %>%
    filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y)) %>%
    left_join(icu, by = "JIPAD_ID")
})
names(D) <- names(keys)
stopifnot(!anyNA(D$full$PT_ID))
sapply(D, nrow)
```

## 1. AUC check against the knitted HTMLs

AUC by the manuscript convention: fitted probabilities of the univariable
logistic regression, evaluated with ROCR (identical to the evaluation Rmds).

```{r auc-check}
auc_glm <- function(d) {
  m <- glm(y ~ x, family = binomial("logit"), data = d)
  p <- predict(m, type = "response")
  ROCR::performance(ROCR::prediction(p, labels = d$y == 1), "auc")@y.values[[1]]
}
chk <- tibble(model = names(D), n = sapply(D, nrow),
              auc = sapply(D, auc_glm),
              auc_html = unname(auc_html[names(D)]),
              diff = auc - auc_html)
chk %>% mutate(across(c(auc, auc_html), ~ round(., 7)), diff = signif(diff, 2))
if (cfg$check_against_html) stopifnot(all(abs(chk$diff) < 1e-6))
```

## 2. Primary result (full model, 160 admissions)

Cluster-robust (patient-level) standard errors for the odds ratios; DeLong
95 % CI for the AUC.

```{r primary}
rep_one <- function(df) {
  df$z <- as.numeric(scale(df$x))
  m1 <- glm(y ~ z, binomial, data = df)              # per 1 SD
  m2 <- glm(y ~ x, binomial, data = df)              # per unit
  b  <- coef(m1)[["z"]]
  se <- sqrt(diag(sandwich::vcovCL(m1, cluster = ~PT_ID)))[["z"]]
  bu <- coef(m2)[["x"]]
  su <- sqrt(diag(sandwich::vcovCL(m2, cluster = ~PT_ID)))[["x"]]
  r  <- pROC::roc(df$y, df$x, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<")
  ci <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(r))
  tibble(n = nrow(df), deaths = sum(df$y), patients = n_distinct(df$PT_ID),
         auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(r)), auc_lo = ci[1], auc_hi = ci[3],
         or_sd = exp(b), or_sd_lo = exp(b - 1.96 * se), or_sd_hi = exp(b + 1.96 * se),
         p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(b / se)),
         or_unit = exp(bu), or_unit_lo = exp(bu - 1.96 * su), or_unit_hi = exp(bu + 1.96 * su))
}
prim <- rep_one(D$full)
prim
```

## 3. Repeated admissions: cluster bootstrap and first admission only

```{r bootstrap}
d <- D$full
set.seed(cfg$seed_bootstrap)
pts <- unique(d$PT_ID); aucs <- numeric(0); ors <- numeric(0)
for (b in seq_len(cfg$B_bootstrap)) {
  sp <- sample(pts, length(pts), replace = TRUE)
  bd <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(sp), function(k) d[d$PT_ID == sp[k], ]))
  if (length(unique(bd$y)) < 2) next
  bd$z <- as.numeric(scale(bd$x))
  aucs <- c(aucs, as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(bd$y, bd$x, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<"))))
  ors  <- c(ors, tryCatch(exp(coef(glm(y ~ z, binomial, data = bd))[["z"]]),
                          error = function(e) NA))
}
ors <- ors[is.finite(ors)]
boot <- tibble(B = length(aucs),
               auc = median(aucs), auc_lo = quantile(aucs, .025), auc_hi = quantile(aucs, .975),
               or_sd = median(ors), or_sd_lo = quantile(ors, .025), or_sd_hi = quantile(ors, .975))

fa <- d %>% group_by(PT_ID) %>% slice_min(ADM_DT, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
fa$z <- as.numeric(scale(fa$x))
mf <- glm(y ~ z, binomial, data = fa)
bf <- coef(mf)[["z"]]; sf <- summary(mf)$coef["z", "Std. Error"]
rf <- pROC::roc(fa$y, fa$x, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<"); cf <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(rf))
first <- tibble(n = nrow(fa), deaths = sum(fa$y),
                or_sd = exp(bf), or_sd_lo = exp(bf - 1.96 * sf), or_sd_hi = exp(bf + 1.96 * sf),
                auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(rf)), auc_lo = cf[1], auc_hi = cf[3])
boot; first
```

## 4. Comparison with aPS-4 (ESM Table 4)

aPS-4 = APACHE II Acute Physiology Score points for temperature, mean blood
pressure, heart rate and respiratory rate, using the last measurement within 3 h
and 12 h before ICU admission; unmeasured items score 0. Ward vitals are joined
to admissions by `PT_ID` and `ADM_DT`.

```{r aps4}
vm <- c(TEMPR = "tempr", BPM = "map", PULSE = "hr", RESP = "rr")
a_t <- function(t) case_when(is.na(t)~0L, t>=41~4L, t>=39~3L, t>=38.5~1L, t>=36~0L, t>=34~1L, t>=32~2L, t>=30~3L, TRUE~4L)
a_m <- function(m) case_when(is.na(m)~0L, m>=160~4L, m>=130~3L, m>=110~2L, m>=70~0L, m>=50~2L, TRUE~4L)
a_h <- function(h) case_when(is.na(h)~0L, h>=180~4L, h>=140~3L, h>=110~2L, h>=70~0L, h>=55~2L, h>=40~3L, TRUE~4L)
a_r <- function(r) case_when(is.na(r)~0L, r>=50~4L, r>=35~3L, r>=25~1L, r>=12~0L, r>=10~1L, r>=6~2L, TRUE~4L)
p5 <- readRDS(cfg$f_p5) %>% ungroup()
dj <- p5 %>% select(-any_of("JIPAD_ID")) %>%
  left_join(icu %>% select(PT_ID, ADM_DT, JIPAD_ID), by = c("PT_ID", "ADM_DT"))
ext <- function(h) dj %>%
  filter(!is.na(JIPAD_ID), nhrs >= -h, nhrs <= 0, name %in% names(vm)) %>%
  group_by(JIPAD_ID, name) %>% arrange(nhrs) %>% slice_tail(n = 1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(v = vm[name]) %>% select(JIPAD_ID, v, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = v, values_from = value, names_prefix = "last_")
need_cols <- function(s) { for (cc in c("last_tempr", "last_map", "last_hr", "last_rr"))
  if (!cc %in% names(s)) s[[cc]] <- NA_real_; s }
score <- function(s) s %>% mutate(APS = a_t(last_tempr) + a_m(last_map) + a_h(last_hr) + a_r(last_rr))
ids <- tibble(JIPAD_ID = unique(icu$JIPAD_ID))
s3  <- ids %>% left_join(ext(3),  by = "JIPAD_ID") %>% need_cols() %>% score()
s12 <- ids %>% left_join(ext(12), by = "JIPAD_ID") %>% need_cols() %>% score()
da <- D$full %>%
  left_join(s3  %>% select(JIPAD_ID, APS_3h  = APS), by = "JIPAD_ID") %>%
  left_join(s12 %>% select(JIPAD_ID, APS_12h = APS), by = "JIPAD_ID")
r_ssm <- pROC::roc(da$y, da$x,       quiet = TRUE, direction = "<")
r_3   <- pROC::roc(da$y, da$APS_3h,  quiet = TRUE, direction = "<")
r_12  <- pROC::roc(da$y, da$APS_12h, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<")
row_of <- function(lab, r, ref = NULL) {
  ci <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(r))
  out <- tibble(predictor = lab, auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(r)), auc_lo = ci[1], auc_hi = ci[3],
                d_auc = NA_real_, p_delong = NA_real_)
  if (!is.null(ref)) {
    tt <- pROC::roc.test(ref, r, method = "delong", paired = TRUE)
    out$d_auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(ref)) - out$auc; out$p_delong <- tt$p.value
  }
  out
}
aps <- bind_rows(row_of("Estimated severity (SSM)", r_ssm),
                 row_of("aPS-4, 3-h window",  r_3,  r_ssm),
                 row_of("aPS-4, 12-h window", r_12, r_ssm))
aps
```

## 5. Leave-one-channel-out (ESM Table 5, Fig. 4)

ΔAUC = AUC(full) − AUC(channel removed), from unrounded AUCs; positive means
discrimination fell when the channel was removed.

```{r loo}
auc_full <- chk$auc[chk$model == "full"]
loo <- chk %>% filter(model %in% c("full", "exTEMPR", "exRESP", "exBPM", "exPULSE")) %>%
  mutate(d_auc = if_else(model == "full", NA_real_, auc_full - auc)) %>%
  select(model, n, auc, d_auc)
loo
```

## 6. Single-channel models (ESM Fig. 3)

```{r single}
beta_of <- function(d) coef(glm(y ~ x, family = binomial("logit"), data = d))[["x"]]
single <- chk %>% filter(model %in% c("onPULSE", "onBPM", "onRESP", "onTEMPR")) %>%
  mutate(beta = sapply(D[model], beta_of)) %>% select(model, n, beta, auc)
single
```

## 8. Convergence of the nine fits (ESM 1.2)

```{r convergence, eval = cfg$run_convergence}
conv <- lapply(names(cfg$fit_files), function(nm) {
  L  <- readRDS(cfg$fit_files[[nm]]); ft <- L[[1]]
  s  <- rstan::summary(ft)$summary
  structural <- grepl("^(as\\[|coef_dt_div$|sigma_ijs_ijss$|pts_base_is\\[)", rownames(s))
  severity   <- grepl("^dmg_ijs\\[", rownames(s))
  sp  <- rstan::get_sampler_params(ft, inc_warmup = FALSE)
  out <- tibble(model = nm, states = nrow(L[[2]]), rows = nrow(L[[3]]),
    rhat_max_struct = max(s[structural, "Rhat"], na.rm = TRUE),
    neff_min_struct = min(s[structural, "n_eff"], na.rm = TRUE),
    rhat_max_sev    = max(s[severity, "Rhat"], na.rm = TRUE),
    neff_min_sev    = min(s[severity, "n_eff"], na.rm = TRUE),
    rhat_max_all    = max(s[, "Rhat"], na.rm = TRUE),
    neff_min_all    = min(s[, "n_eff"], na.rm = TRUE),
    divergent       = sum(vapply(sp, function(x) sum(x[, "divergent__"]), numeric(1))),
    treedepth_hits  = sum(vapply(sp, function(x) sum(x[, "treedepth__"] >= 15), numeric(1))))
  rm(L, ft, s, sp); invisible(gc())
  out
}) %>% bind_rows()
conv
write.csv(conv, file.path(cfg$out, "convergence_v23.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## 10. Manuscript-ready numbers

```{r summary}
f3 <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x); f2 <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
sgn <- function(x) sprintf("%+.3f", x)
L <- c(
  sprintf("Cohort: %d admissions, %d patients, %d deaths within 30 days",
          prim$n, prim$patients, prim$deaths),
  sprintf("Primary: AUC %s (95%% CI %s-%s); OR per 1-SD %s (95%% CI %s-%s), p = %s; OR per unit %s (95%% CI %s-%s)",
          f3(prim$auc), f3(prim$auc_lo), f3(prim$auc_hi), f2(prim$or_sd), f2(prim$or_sd_lo),
          f2(prim$or_sd_hi), f3(prim$p), f2(prim$or_unit), f2(prim$or_unit_lo), f2(prim$or_unit_hi)),
  sprintf("Cluster bootstrap (B = %d): AUC %s (%s-%s); OR per 1-SD %s (%s-%s)",
          boot$B, f3(boot$auc), f3(boot$auc_lo), f3(boot$auc_hi),
          f2(boot$or_sd), f2(boot$or_sd_lo), f2(boot$or_sd_hi)),
  sprintf("First admission only (n = %d, deaths = %d): OR per 1-SD %s (%s-%s); AUC %s (%s-%s)",
          first$n, first$deaths, f2(first$or_sd), f2(first$or_sd_lo), f2(first$or_sd_hi),
          f3(first$auc), f3(first$auc_lo), f3(first$auc_hi)),
  sprintf("aPS-4: %s", paste(sprintf("%s AUC %s (%s-%s)%s", aps$predictor, f3(aps$auc),
          f3(aps$auc_lo), f3(aps$auc_hi),
          ifelse(is.na(aps$p_delong), "", sprintf(", dAUC %s, DeLong p = %s",
                 sgn(aps$d_auc), f3(aps$p_delong)))), collapse = "; ")),
  sprintf("Leave-one-out: %s", paste(sprintf("%s %s%s", loo$model, f3(loo$auc),
          ifelse(is.na(loo$d_auc), "", sprintf(" (dAUC %s)", sgn(loo$d_auc)))), collapse = "; ")),
  sprintf("Single channel: %s", paste(sprintf("%s %s (n = %d, beta %s)", single$model,
          f3(single$auc), single$n, sprintf("%+.3f", single$beta)), collapse = "; ")),
  sprintf("Software: %s", paste(names(sw), sw, sep = " ", collapse = "; ")))
writeLines(L, file.path(cfg$out, "final_numbers_v23.txt"))
cat(L, sep = "\n")
num <- bind_rows(
  prim %>% mutate(block = "primary"), boot %>% mutate(block = "bootstrap"),
  first %>% mutate(block = "first_admission"),
  aps %>% rename(model = predictor) %>% mutate(block = "aps4"),
  loo %>% mutate(block = "leave_one_out"), single %>% mutate(block = "single_channel"))
write.csv(num, file.path(cfg$out, "final_numbers_v23.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
